name: Dark Folk, Neoclassical Folk
description: Neoclassical Folk is a dark folk subgenre characterized by orchestral instrumentation, classical composition structures, and chamber-folk aesthetics. It blends neofolk’s acoustic, earthy darkness with neoclassical elements like string ensembles, piano, and choral vocals. This niche sits under the Dark Folk umbrella (alongside sibling styles like Apocalyptic Folk, Martial Folk, Pagan Folk, etc.)

name: Genre: Ambient Techno
description: Ambient Techno is a subgenre that fuses the driving, hypnotic rhythmic foundations of techno with the atmospheric, expansive textures of ambient music. It prioritizes mood, sound design, and immersive "headspace" over traditional dance-floor energy, typically featuring subtle, recurring synth pads, deep melodic layers, and a steady, unobtrusive beat.

name: Genre: Drone / Minimal Ambient
description: Drone/Minimal Ambient is a genre defined by extreme sonic reduction and sustained, evolving soundscapes. It prioritizes texture, resonance, and slow temporal shifts over traditional melody or rhythm, utilizing long-duration tones (drones) and sparse arrangements to create a meditative, immersive environment where the listener's focus shifts from musical progression to the physical experience of sound itself.

name: Genre: Indietronica
description: Indietronica is a hybrid genre that blends the DIY spirit, song-oriented structures, and guitar-driven aesthetic of indie rock with the synthetic textures and production techniques of electronic music. It is characterized by the integration of sequencers, drum machines, and synthesizers into traditional rock instrumentation, resulting in a sound that remains intimate and melodic while exploring experimental, glitch-influenced, or lo-fi electronic arrangements.

name: Genre: Melodic Techno
description: Melodic Techno is a subgenre that marries the steady, driving 4/4 pulse of techno with rich, emotive harmonic layers and intricate synthesizer melodies. Unlike the more abrasive or stripped-back industrial forms of the genre, Melodic Techno emphasizes atmosphere, epic builds, and poignant chord progressions, creating a sound that is both club-ready and deeply cinematic or melancholic in nature.

name: Genre: Modern Prog Rock
description: Modern Progressive Rock is a genre that blends the intricate musicianship, long-form compositions, and conceptual depth of 1970s prog with contemporary production techniques, modern heavy metal elements, and atmospheric textures. It is defined by its refusal to adhere to traditional song structures, prioritizing technical virtuosity, complex time signatures, and immersive, often cinematic, soundscapes.

name: MTV Unplugged
description: Started at the end of the 80s with Bon Jovi, the MTV unplugged series quickly became the place to be for trendy groups... in unplugged style! Nearly all the big names had their turn: Eagles, Bob Dylan, Björk, Alanis Morissette, R.E.M., The Corrs, Neil Young, Oasis, Jimmy Page & Robert Plant, Mariah Carey, Florence + The Machine... But two concerts in particular stand out: Eric Clapton and Nirvana who respectively sold 7 and 5 million copies of their "MTV Unplugged" performances.
